# Synthetic example: supplier orders

**The data are invented.** `orders_synthetic.csv` holds 400 supplier orders generated by
`make_orders_synthetic.py` (seeded pseudo-random numbers, standard library only). The suppliers
(`Supplier_A` ... `Supplier_E`), orders, prices and outcomes do not describe real companies or transactions.
Use the files to learn the workflow, not to draw conclusions.

| File | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `orders_synthetic.csv` | one row per order: date, supplier, category, quantity, unit price, discount, defective units, delivery status, lead time, compliance check; first line is a `#` comment saying the data are synthetic |
| `make_orders_synthetic.py` | regenerates the CSV byte for byte (`python make_orders_synthetic.py`) |
| `orders_spec.json` | a criteria spec: 6 indicators in a hierarchy of 4 main criteria (Delivery with 3 sub-criteria) |

Copy the files to a working folder with `ahp-bench example --out DIR`, then follow the walk-through printed by
that command (or the one in the skill, `skills/llm-ahp-mcdm/SKILL.md`).
